origin: Explosia's LOVEX Reloading Guide 2019 (rifle tables: loads, V5 velocities, pressures; tools/loaddata)
descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 198 start and maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (25 cartridges), velocity error 4.5 % rms, pressure error 16 % rms (published pressures). Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: Qex (the type follows the name (S = single base, D = double base)), k, material density pc, bulk density pcd, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.
